# noqeri/semver

Strict, allocation-free Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 parsing and precedence comparison for Noqeri. It rejects leading-zero numeric identifiers, validates prerelease/build identifiers, exposes parsed major/minor/patch values, and compares prerelease identifiers without integer overflow.

License: GPL-3.0-only.
